command: cd packages/runtime && HOME=/Users/roasbeef gleam run -m pending_read_bench
unit: elapsed wall milliseconds per 50 complete read-and-decode loads including correctness assertions
limits: Shared loaded host, not isolated CPU or daemon measurements.
Fixed memory then SQLite, backlog/width and baseline-point-bulk order.
Methods share the seeded store and warm-cache state; no cold reset per method.
All cells use the same roughly 1 KiB pending payload; no payload-diversity or cache-pressure claim.
One-millisecond resolution; zero timings do not prove zero cost.
Separate Erlang probes describe their own VM, not each benchmark VM.
